canonical_project: DCA | PIER Canning Vale data centre
owner: DC Alliance / Pier DC Pty Ltd (AsiaPhos acquisition)
notes: DCA | PIER is an Uptime Institute certified Tier III data centre at 1 Martin Place, Canning Vale industrial area, ~20km from Perth CBD, serving enterprise and government customers. w.media and The Edge Singapore report the facility operates a 2MW power installation supporting ~700kW of IT load with plans for modular expansion to 8MW; AsiaPhos agreed to acquire a majority stake in DC Alliance (owner of Pier DC) in 2026. Capacity 2 = current power installation, 8 = expansion target.
